paper.title_en: Hidden symmetries and the universality of Hawking radiation
paper.abstract_en: Quantum tunneling of particles across a black hole (BH) horizon provides an intuitive interpretation of Hawking radiation (HR), yielding a conceptually simple derivation of the thermal spectrum within a semiclassical framework. However, for BHs obeying the no-hair theorem, usual implementations of the complex-path (Hamilton-Jacobi) method typically rely on approximating the metric near the BH horizon. In this work, we demonstrate that the Hawking spectrum can be derived without such approximations by exploiting gauge invariance in quantum field theory and the separability of the Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) equation arising from hidden symmetries of these spacetimes. However, for BHs obeying the no-hair theorem, usual implementations of the complex-path (Hamilton--Jacobi) method typically rely on approximating the metric near the horizon. This perspective shows explicitly why the BH behaves as an effective $(1+1)$-dimensional blackbody at the event horizon, provides the conditions needed to extend the HR to higher-spin particles, and offers a framework that can naturally incorporate back-reaction and quantum-gravity effects.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文讨论利用时空隐藏对称性与规范不变性，在不做视界附近度规近似的情况下推导霍金辐射谱，并由此说明黑洞在事件视界处表现为有效(1+1)维黑体、给出推广到高自旋粒子的条件，并可与反作用及量子引力效应衔接。主题属于黑洞热力学与广义相对论基础，理论深度较高，方法上借助Hamilton-Jacobi方程可分离性与量子场论中的规范不变性，具有明确的概念新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 隐藏对称性与霍金辐射的普适性
decision.abstract_zh: 粒子穿过黑洞视界的量子隧穿为霍金辐射提供了一种直观解释，在半经典框架内给出了热谱的一个概念上简单的推导。然而，对于服从无毛定理的黑洞，复路径（Hamilton-Jacobi）方法的通常实现往往依赖于在黑洞视界附近对度规做近似。在本工作中，我们表明，通过利用量子场论中的规范不变性以及由这些时空的隐藏对称性所导致的 Hamilton-Jacobi（HJ）方程的可分离性，可以在不做此类近似的情况下推导出霍金谱。然而，对于服从无毛定理的黑洞，复路径（Hamilton--Jacobi）方法的通常实现往往依赖于在视界附近对度规做近似。这一视角明确显示了为何黑洞在事件视界处表现为一个有效的 (1+1) 维黑体，给出了将霍金辐射推广到高自旋粒子所需的条件，并提供了一个能够自然地纳入反作用和量子引力效应的框架。
